==Russian==

===Pronunciation===
* {{ru-IPA|ступи́ть}}

===Etymology 1===
{{inh+|ru|orv|ступити}}, from {{inh|ru|sla-pro|*stǫpiti}}, from {{der|ru|ine-pro|*stab-||to support}}.

Compare {{cog|hsb|stupić}}, {{cog|pl|stąpić}}, {{cog|cs|stoupit}}, {{cog|sh|stupiti}}.

====Verb====
{{ru-verb|ступи́ть|pf|impf=ступа́ть}}

# to [[tread]], to [[step]] on
#: {{uxi|ru|'''ступи́ть''' [[на]] [[земля|зе́млю]]|to [[set foot]] on land}}

=====Conjugation=====
